purpose: Owner-local registered-buffer writes and fenced manifest-last publication of logical head partitions through Mooncake Store

interfaces.SnapshotWriter.write_partition: Validates the complete manifest and exactly the local owner's tensors, registers descriptors, waits for Store puts and Catalog WRITTEN ACK, then returns OwnerWriteReceipt.
interfaces.SnapshotWriter.publish_partitions: Requires exactly one matching receipt per declared owner; registers the manifest, journals exact bytes, seals against Catalog WRITTEN descriptors, writes the manifest and publishes.
interfaces.validate_tensors(owner_id=...): Validates full logical coverage plus local checksums, finite values and exact object set; the aux owner also validates tokens, teacher IDs/values, positions and loss masks.

jobs.note: Broad suite before the final explicit None-owner guard and fixture namespace isolation; affected writer cases rerun in the final job.

store_observation.inference: synthetic logical TP2 tensor partitions; no distributed model forward

assertions: Each independent writer registers and puts only its local Host tensors; neither needs another owner's tensor buffers.
Malformed or incomplete local object sets, unknown owners and invalid aux masks are rejected before Catalog or Store writes.
Missing, duplicate, foreign-owner, stale-fence, foreign-capture and changed-manifest receipts cannot publish.
A lost owner WRITTEN response returns no receipt; retry reuses identical immutable Store objects.
A lost seal response leaves the publication journal recoverable without any owner's original Host buffers.
The test reader helper reconstructs full token/head tensors by declared logical ranges, independent of descriptor/owner order.
Both writer processes exit before publication; a separate storage segment retains their objects and a fresh reader process validates them.
The original registered-arena single-owner Store roundtrip also passes.
limits: The serving scheduler still rejects TP/PP/DP capture. Distributed admission, synchronized metadata collection, canonical replicated-head ownership, rank-local Host pools and TP/PP model integration remain pending.
The new interface assumes a coordinator has already assembled and distributed one immutable full manifest; it does not implement that distributed coordinator.
Owner receipts are trusted producer acknowledgements, not signed Catalog attestations or retention leases. Catalog seal must verify all exact WRITTEN descriptors and the current fence.
Before a complete receipt set reaches the publication journal, capture failure and object cleanup remain the caller/Catalog's responsibility; producer exit alone does not authorize deletion.
Real transport is local TCP, not cross-node RDMA. The Catalog is a test double and no production consumer or SLO is certified.
